notes.title: Update: Teleportation locomotion added! Episode SALE started!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33360089/e19f0c2127136f99a5dfc7405ac19a7a3d9c5c03.gif
Good news is here:
Our first sale on STEAM is live. Save 35% this week on PROZE: Enlightenment and Original Soundtrack.

The better news is here as well:
We've added Teleportation locomotion to PROZE.

Now PROZE has 3 movement options:
1.Free locomotion (adjustable)
2.Point & Teleport Locomotion
3.3DRudder (foot controller)

We hope that you will be pleased to progress through PROZE 
as it best fits your level of comfort.
Hope you enjoy PROZE: Prologue. 
Don't forget to share your experience and check out 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/924250/PROZE_Enlightenment/


Many thanks.
SignSine team.

notes.title: PROZE Release Date
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33360089/795acffe2cc9f63ed31ce3f9a5666dfe4bd0b8cd.png
Hi everyone,

We’re working hard to bring to you the best possible experience in PROZE Episode I: Enlightenment. Everything looks promising and we’re almost at the finish line – but need a little more time to wrap things up. The first full chapter of PROZE story will be out on April 11. 

We’re excited to share the game’s trailer with you soon. Stay tuned and don’t forget to subscribe to our newsletter and sign up for the beta test!

notes.title: The final update is out!
PROZE: Episode I release date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
First of all, a huge thanks to everyone who played and continues to play PROZE: Prologue! Your comments and reviews have helped to make it a much better experience.

Also, the original release date for the first full episode of PROZE was set for November. However, we’ve considered our work on the Prologue chapter and decided that we want to bring you a truly immersive VR experience – adding more detailed visuals and animations, new gameplay mechanics, additional localizations, and an expanded narrative with an epic ending. So we need a little more time for that.

PROZE Episode I: Enlightenment now releases in February 2019.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/924250/PROZE_Episode_I_Enlightenment/
Stay tuned!
